spans.text: Paradeus' temporary base.
Hum... Nemhran activates a system that has been off for a long time, and the base that has been vacant for days is once again in operation.
After confirming the system's status, she turns to address the person behind her matter-of-factly.
...The channel connecting to the Lake of Cognition has been completely sealed.
Before the backup plan puts things right, try to avoid combat.
Embla has already set off to implement her "All Hallows' Eve".
I may be too cautious here... but can she be trusted?
As the control group of the experiment, she has already completed her mission. All that's left is to make good use of her identity.
Tut-tut, I would love to be a fly on the wall...
When the Commander finds out their boss was the one who sent this woman to us...
...Watch your tongue.
Am I wrong?
Humans are always spouting lofty ideals that contradict their foul and unscrupulous actions.
Haven't you picked up that bad habit yourself?
Oh my, and here I thought you'd be more forgiving of my selfish little hobby.
...I just find your behavior unnecessary.
We are all chosen enforcers, little more than pawns in chess.
...Do you not have any kind of pursuits... or dare I say, desires, Sister Nemhran?
...We are not close enough to discuss such things.
You're right.
Then let's change the subject.
Why did Father abandon Avernus?
Why do you think he risked his own life to meet the Commander in person?
He did not abandon Avernus. He simply made it possible for it to land safely in Frankfurt.
To have it moved from the Black Zone to the White Zone.
As Nytos, we are considered "aliens" in human society, and Father wishes to change that.
How very ridiculous. We are just as "human" as they are.
That's exactly Father's point.
With this operation, we will officially step onto the humans' stage.
As "second-class citizens"?
No, perhaps as first-class citizens.
Are you so sure that the elites will think of us as equals?
They don't consider themselves citizens...
...But gods.
You are much harsher than me, Sister Nemhran.
Humans treat each other much more cruelly than we do.
Morridow, I don't want what happened to Grig and Gray to happen again.
We can't produce high-end Nytos at the moment, so we will be on the back foot for a while.
If we lose Bramedb as well, I'm sure you know the consequences.
I have no idea what you're talking about.
Don't you?
Nemhran gives Morridow a cold, hard look before turning back to her work.
Instead of leaving, Morridow takes another step closer.
Can you finally tell me what "All Hallows' Eve" is all about?
Embla will walk the earth.
Resurrected as the ordinary human "Angelia".
She will prove to all humans... that eternal life is not a pipe dream.
Eternal life... An eternal temptation for humans.
That's what Father wants us to do.
To stage a small debut of Paradeus' technology.
What about the cost? Will the humans know the price they'll have to pay in exchange for this kind of eternal life?
Humans are short-sighted creatures who will happily give up long-term plans for the sake of some immediate benefit.
Father's plan is beyond their comprehension—not that they need to comprehend it.
I see.
Morridow slowly backs away before turning to leave the hall.
...Embla, will you really do as she wishes?
Will you carry out such a simple mission?
I shall wait and see.
Scherbius-Andrew-Platz, Frankfurt District, Frankfurt.
Embla strolls leisurely around the fountain. A large poster of "Faust" is hanging on the exterior of the Alte Oper.
The Alte Oper is closed today, plus the weather is rather chilly, so the area is largely deserted. She slowly walks up to the poster alone and unobserved.
In her hands is a paper bag filled with Devil's bread that is fresh out of the oven.
Small specks of snow start falling. Embla looks up at the night sky lit up by the city lights.
Such a beautiful Halloween should be celebrated with the most interesting game.
The show is about to begin. Will my guests arrive in time, I wonder?
She pulls out a small piece of bread and takes a dainty bite. It does not taste particularly delicious with the overpowering spices, but as a kind of festive delicacy, it is sufficiently delightful.
Beep.
Graff, is our corn maze ready yet?
Of course, Sister Embla. All the actors and props are in position.
Once you are here, we can kickstart this exhilarating "All Hallows' Eve".
Embla terminates the call. She breathes out a ghostly plume into the frosty air as she studies the sculptures of Pegasus and each of the Muses that adorn the rooftop of the building.
She enters the Alte Oper from the main entrance and ambles through the vestibule.
As early as Shakespeare's time, the story has already been written.
How can "Faust", a work from hundreds of years ago, retain its glory across the ages?
Every generation has its own stories, and each story has its own adaptations.
"When man pursues his dream, he becomes a slave to the Devil's schemes."
"But should he taste fulfillment's light, he'll soar to hope's celestial height."
Dear audience, please enjoy my new version of "Faust"...
On All Hallows' Eve.
Only a moth knows how mesmerizing the flame is.
Despite knowing what final fate awaits it, it still hurtles towards its own demise without hesitation.
Is death the final destination?
Every time I wake... I smell something different in the air.
It never fails to make me feel nostalgic.
Ange...
...Will you save me a spot in the brave new world?
Click. Embla flips the light switch. The wall sconces shaped like candelabras start emitting swaying, flickering lights.
Tap... Tap, tap... A strange noise is coming from deep inside the opera house.
Under the faint light, she climbs the stairs and comes to the staff room entrance on the second floor.
When she pushes the door open, the noise ceases.
Embla promptly scans the room. A few props are scattered here and there, and a cast list is taped on the wall.
Tut-tut, Bramedb has also come up with her own version, huh.
So she's playing Helen of Troy...
Embla leans forward and studies the cast list with great interest.
Bramedb seems to be playing the main character, and most of the performance time slots are filled with the name "Helen".
Unfortunately, the slots are now all marked "canceled".
If the Devil can satisfy all your heart's desires, will you sell your soul?
Embla starts humming softly as her fingers brush softly across a copy of the script laid aside.
Beep-beep-beep.
Just then, her communicator chirps.
Who's this?
—Atta—
Hm?
...We're under attack!!
It's DEFY!
Sister Embla... in the Alte Oper...
Bang-bang!
Pzzzt...
The line is dead.
My, my.
Detecting movement coming from behind, Embla whirls around out of reflex.
But once she sees who it is, she lets out a sigh of relief.
A black Nyto strolls casually into the room. Then she turns around and makes to close the door.
You're here? Then I gather so is everyone else.
RPK-16, do you see how this will end for you?
Snap.
The lights go out instantly.
Embla hears a sharp hiss as something tears through the air—
Boom!
...You're not holding back at all.
Embla rolls aside in the dark to avoid being hit by the armor-piercing round that has been aimed directly at her.
Bang-bang-bang! Not giving her any time to react, another string of bullets are already hot on her heels as she dashes into the Großer Saal.
The gunfire forces Embla onto the exposed stage.
Creeeak... The door of the Large Hall is shut.
Embla is now on stage.
The spotlight overhead follows her relentlessly. The chandelier hanging at the center of the ceiling is dazzlingly bright.
Another followspot shines onto the black Nyto, who is now standing in the auditorium.
What a fitting place for you to meet your end.
12, why aren't you using your new frame?
Are you really so put off by my tastes?
Just bear with it for a little. That was one of the few remaining Doll frames in Avernus, and the most advanced one to boot.
It may just be better than Shaw's handiwork.
...No one can outdo Shaw.
Standing in the beam of light, the black Nyto gazes coldly at Embla like a specter.
Basking in the stage light, Embla fully embraces her role as the prima donna and puts on a graceful smile.
So, is everyone in Task Force DEFY here?
We're getting front-row seats to watch you die.
We wouldn't miss this for the world.
Embla takes some time to scrutinize the interior of the Großer Saal. This particular hall is the most fully restored and most resplendent venue within the Alte Oper.
The auditorium has three levels of seating and can accommodate more than 2,000 people.
However, there are only three people in her current audience.

Embla looks toward the balcony. That would be AN-94's preferred location from which to offer assistance in defense, because when AK-15 is present, everyone automatically leaves the door for her to defend.
AN-94, the "Snow Wolf" of DEFY.
Featuring enhanced melee capability and firepower after the upgrade.
Embla does not even have to look for AK-15. She is, as always, at the most eye-catching position.
That by the door is AK-15, the "White Mastiff" of DEFY.
The most powerful T-Doll in the entire Neo-Soviet Union.
But 12, I don't like the way you are right now.
The black Nyto is standing right at the center of the stalls.
She is as cold as a statue.
I still prefer the frame I chose for you.
Under the dazzling chandelier, for the first time in several days, Task Force DEFY is reunited.
Please allow me to present a Halloween's special program.
"Faust", adapted by and starring Frau Embla, shall now begin!
Act One—In Search of Faust.
Embla claps her hands.
Come on out, my Mephistos.
The curtain rises gradually on stage, revealing a group of fully-armed Paradeus units that fill the entire stage behind Embla.
Bang-bang-bang!
A hail of bullets rain down on the stalls, and the black Nyto instantly collapses onto the floor.
Where art thou, Faust?
I seek thee still, rushing toward thee with unyielding will.
All that is promised shall delight thee purely;
No skinflint bargain shalt thou see.
I am not one of the greatest, yet, wilt thou to me entrust thy steps through life, I'll guide thee,—
Will willingly walk beside thee,— Will serve thee at once and forever, with best endeavor...
The sounds of gunfire and impact intertwine into a dramatic concerto that Embla's singing transforms into a beautiful movement.
The Paradeus units surge toward the two remaining members of the audience.
Bang-bang-bang!
With incredible coordination, AK-15 and AN-94 fire at the rapidly approaching wave of white.
Their modified frames are all too experienced in fighting Paradeus.
These low-tier Paradeus units give them no reason to fear at all in terms of strength and combat skills.
The only inscrutable wild card is the being standing on the stage... a woman both familiar and unfamiliar...
With unhinged eyes and a rapturous smile.
...And, if thou art satisfied, will as servant, slave, with thee abide.
Set wigs of million curls upon thy head, to raise thee...
Wear shoes an ell in height,—the truth betrays thee.
Embla watches with an amused smile as the Nytos surge forth to overpower the two Dolls.
AK-15 will never falter, so the one on the balcony is naturally being targeted as the Nytos try to break through their defenses.
Bang-bang-bang!
Bam!
AN-94's position is attacked by multiple Nytos. Under the wavering light, they dart in and out of the shadows, falling upon her incessantly like minions from Hell.
...I won't let you get your way.
Embla knows DEFY well, but so does AN-94.
AN-94 knows exactly what Embla is up to. She is trying to locate AK-12, who has vanished out of sight. As long as AK-12 is still around, nobody dares make a move.
...Don't underestimate me, 16.
AN-94 pulls up one of the Paradeus units near her and uses it to block the long-range attacks coming from the stage.
She reloads quickly.
Then she shifts into a different attack mode.
...If you think of me as the weakest link...
I'll turn this place into your grave.
AN-94 vaults lightly over the railing of the balcony. She is aware that Embla is intimately familiar with the "geography" of this place, but so is she.
In a theater like this, the quickest way to get from the balcony to the stage...
...Is not via the stairs in the back, nor is it to clamber over the Nyto corpses in front of her.
It is...
The chandelier overhead.
Are you not going to fight back, RPK?!
Or are you ready to atone for your sins?
AN-94 leaps nimbly up the chandelier and flies toward the woman standing at center stage like a bullet ejected from the muzzle of a gun.
Bang!
Things do not go according to plan.
A large scythe is swung toward AN-94 on the chandelier—by a Nyto lurking on the other side of the ceiling fixture in her blind spot.
Sister Embla is spot-on.
Graff lets out a triumphant cackle from her hiding place and hits AN-94 in the shoulder while she is airborne.
Whoosh!
Like a bird with broken wings... a meteor that breaks through the atmosphere... AN-94 falls towards the stalls in the auditorium...
Awaiting her down there is countless Paradeus units with their blades raised and poised to strike.
Bang-bang-bang!
Gunfire is unleashed upon the Nytos below AN-94.
The location of the attacker is revealed by the direction in which they collapse.
Why, on the whole, thou'rt—what thou art.
And thou remainest—what thou art.
Embla finishes her song and smiles with great satisfaction.
There you are, 12.
Embla snaps her fingers, and a screen descends from above.
A new batch of Paradeus units appear on the battlefield.
Bang-bang-bang!
AN-94 finally shoots down the two remaining Nytos close at hand, earning herself a brief moment of respite.
12, won't you let me set eyes upon you?
Tough crowd. In that case, you answer the question, Graff.
Do you know what is the scariest thing that can happen to a wolf pack?
Graff jumps off the lighting bar.
...Please enlighten me, Sister Embla.
Being without their "alpha wolf".
That's why when fighting Task Force DEFY, one must first find the one who lurks in the shadows.
And after that?
After that, we have our brilliant cast ask them for a dance.
Embla smiles at the Nyto and points toward the stalls ahead as she explains patiently.
To neutralize AN-94 the Snow Wolf, one could try electronic warfare. Let our EW expert "Bramedb" give her a taste of Paradeus' torrents of data.
Yes, Sister.
As for the White Mastiff, she is created for one reason and one reason only—to fight. Let "Morridow" open her eyes and show her the power of traps.
Now, for the one hiding on the ceiling.
That's our Alpha Wolf—
AK-12. What is her forte?
Everything.
Because the frame she is using is the most cutting-edge mechanical product that Paradeus can currently create.
Then... then who do we send against her?
"Nemhran", of course. Alpha wolf against alpha wolf.
Understood.
Embla looks up and raises her hand toward the brilliant chandelier above her head.
Now that we've found Faust, let's begin Act Two!
Act Two—The Never-Ending Dance
Thunk.
The dazzling chandelier, the blinding spotlights, the dim wall lights all go out in an instant...
Plunging everything into darkness.
Stay where you are.
Task Force DEFY calmly activate their Eyes of the Snow Wolf, all the while listening carefully for every movement on the stage.
Rustle...
Something seems to be approaching in the excruciating darkness.
Whoosh!
Light instantly rends the darkness and illuminates the resplendent stage.
Where the light shines the brightest, bone spurs stretch out wildly, blooming with infinite vitality and wrapping Embla, the prima donna at center stage, in a flurry of overlapping layers of white.
The white of her long dress lights up the entire stage. The sharp spikes protract in a fractal pattern, and the woman in their midst holds out her arms at the auditorium.
Hello, at last.
